title: KnowledgeEnrichment
description: Design proposal, not yet implemented (Phase 8). One record per normalized item (see normalized_knowledge.schema.json), keyed by item_id, stored SEPARATELY from the normalized JSON -- never merged in. See knowledge_enrichment.md for full rationale and the deterministic/rule-based/LLM classification of every field.

GenerationMethod.description: How THIS SPECIFIC field's value was produced -- see knowledge_enrichment.md's classification. 'not_populated' means the field was deliberately left empty (e.g. no glossary/regex match), not that it failed.

ReasoningType.description: Controlled vocabulary, extended only via explicit rule additions in enrich_knowledge_deterministic.py's verb glossary -- never free text.

ExerciseType.description: null when the item's type is not activity/exercise/example (theorem/property/definition/remark are never exercise-shaped).

MathematicalEntities.description: Regex-extracted LaTeX constructs -- literal substrings of `content`, never interpreted. Empty arrays are the honest default.

functions.description: e.g. 'f', 'g', 'v \circ u' -- single/short identifiers immediately followed by '(' in the LaTeX source.

EnrichmentRecord.description: One record per normalized item, keyed by item_id.

item_id.description: FK to a normalized item's own id -- reused verbatim, never regenerated.

item_type.description: Denormalized copy of the normalized item's `type`, for readability only -- the normalized JSON remains authoritative.

topics.description: Controlled vocabulary = the chapter's own section/subsection titles (deterministic; see field-by-field rationale). May later gain additional canonical topic labels from an LLM pass for coarse-bucket items (Phase B) -- tracked via generation_methods.topics, never silently.

keywords.description: Controlled-glossary substring matches against `content` (see knowledge_enrichment.md's glossary proposal) -- not free-text extraction.

concepts.description: Rule-based bootstrap: deduplicated union of (a) the item's own topics and (b) canonical concept labels mapped from keyword glossary hits. Intended to eventually populate the EXISTING (currently always-empty) Concept registry in knowledge_item.schema.json -- see knowledge_enrichment.md #6.

generation_methods.description: One GenerationMethod per populated field above -- makes every value's provenance explicit and auditable.

review_status.description: 'NOT_REQUIRED' only when every generation_methods value is deterministic/rule_based/not_populated. Any field produced by 'llm' forces at least REVIEW_REQUIRED -- mirrors the project's existing validation_status/review conventions (knowledge_item.schema.json, figure review, association review); never silently trusted.

items.description: One EnrichmentRecord per normalized item -- see knowledge_enrichment.md.
